plugins.text: Toshe-toshe suna ƙara abin da za ka iya yi a nan. Kowanne yana aiki dabam da fayiloli da maɓallanka, kuma yana yin abin da ka ba da izini kawai lokacin da ka ƙara shi.
plugins.nothing: Babu komai: aiki kawai yake yi.
plugins.right.watch: Ganin komai a cikin tattaunawarka yayin da ake ajiye shi: duk abin da aka rubuta a ciki, fayilolin da kake rabawa, da kowane aiki kafin a yi shi
plugins.right.change: Canja abin da yake gani kafin ya ci gaba
plugins.right.refuse: Dakatar da wani aiki, ko fara tambayarka
plugins.right.loosen: Bari ayyuka su ci gaba ba tare da fara tambayarka ba
plugins.error.address: Wannan ba adireshin toshe ba ne.
plugins.error.fetch: Ba a iya karanta shi daga can ba.
plugins.error.json: Ba a iya karanta plugin.json ɗinsa ba.
plugins.error.format: An yi shi don wani juyi.
plugins.error.name: Sunansa zai iya ƙunsar ƙananan haruffa, lambobi da layuka kawai.
plugins.error.main: Lambarsa dole ta zama fayil ɗin JavaScript kusa da plugin.json ɗinsa.
plugins.error.rights: Yana neman abin da toshe-toshe ba za su iya yi ba.
plugins.error.size: Lambarsa ta yi girma da yawa.
plugins.failed: {title} bai fara ba, don haka a kashe yake yanzu.
plugins.confirmRemove: A cire {title}? Abin da ya ajiye zai tafi tare da shi.
